title: A week of every bus and streetcar in Philadelphia
description:
A week of every bus and streetcar in Philadelphia, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Philadelphia city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Frequent and Trolley, with Standard in grey.

Busiest moment: 640 vehicles, Wednesday at 3:34 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night.
